core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/build-test.yml, added a new 'optimize_ci' job that uses graphite-ci-action, then updated all subsequent jobs to depend on it and add conditional skip checks (e.g., if: needs.optimize_ci.outputs.skip != 'true').
